candidates.title: Bilibili is rolling out HAI ('Codename H'), a script-to-video AI tool that turns a ~1,000-word script into a ~6-minute video, positioned as a native competitor to CapCut AI for creators

evidence.provenance: KrAsia frames this as Bilibili's next-phase monetization and creator-retention push, in a summer 2026 rollout; the same feature set is independently described by AI-tooling blog BibiGPT.

candidates.title: 'Quiet livestreaming' -- calm, soft-sell live commerce is displacing hard-sell Douyin/Taobao-style hosting on Xiaohongshu (e.g. celebrity host Annie Yi drawing 2.2M viewers / ~$4.1M sales with a low-key format)

evidence.provenance: Jing Daily reports the soft-sell format outperforming loud hard-sell norms as younger consumers tire of high-pressure livestream sales; independently listed as one of Xiaohongshu/RED's 2026 'Top 10 Buzzwords' by China Skinny.
